scientific_integrity: Proof-based mathematical claim with independently checkable finite computations; a self-review has been performed but independent audit has not.
scientific_limitations: The inverse-bandwidth law is restricted to three vertical frequency cosets with horizontal integer Fourier frequencies; the Pell asymptotic is subsequential. No unrestricted best-basis optimum is claimed.
title: A sharp inverse-bandwidth law for almost-tight exponential bases on a nonspectral three-segment measure
